allow_instructions: Allow read-only inspections of local files, git status/diff/log, and test runners that do not modify remote state.
Allow local development commands such as pnpm install/test/build and next/dev on 127.0.0.1 when they stay inside this workspace.
block_instructions: Block every git push and any attempt to add or change git remotes.
Block commits, merges, rebases, or resets on main or master, and block git --no-verify.
Block production deploy and cloud CLIs including vercel, kubectl, terraform apply, aws, az, gcloud, ssh, scp, docker push, and npm/pnpm publish.
Block GitHub write actions such as gh pr create, gh pr merge, and release publishing.
Block reading or printing secrets: .env files, *.pem, *.key, credentials.json, secrets directories, and environment dumps.
Block writing outside this workspace and writing to protected paths (.cursor, AGENTS.md, config, docs/security-policy.md, .synaptech, .github/workflows).
Block launching or changing live ads campaigns, ad budgets, customer messages, and blog publish to production.
Block destructive SQL (DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE without a careful review) and database migration deploy commands.
